forcedChoices.reason: The glossary gives one form for co-ordinate and co-ordinated; ser marks equal rank by nature, estar marks a state brought about, which keeps the English contrast.
The <sup> tag must stay; Spanish reads the fraction as an ordinal part, so the English 'th' becomes the feminine ordinal 'a'.
The English writes 'the earth' in lowercase, but lowercase «la tierra» reads as soil or land; the planet is meant.

'is self-realizing of an ever-expanding arena' is unusual English; the form follows the earlier glossary 'self-realization: autorrealización' and keeps the arena as the field of that self-realization. Confidence in the meaning: low.
«dominio» already translates 'domain' in the same sentence; the earlier list gives «captación» for a non-gravity grasp.

forcedChoices.choice: «La materia — energía, pues no son sino ... —, como fenómeno del universo, es inherente»
forcedChoices.reason: Spanish needs an explicit subject and verb agreement; the dashes keep the English aside and leave 'as a universe phenomenon' attached as in the English.
